title: Open Pickleball Research Commons v0.1: Supplementary Research Infrastructure
description: Frozen supplementary research infrastructure supporting the Current Opinion 'Building Cumulative Science in an Emerging Sport: The Open Pickleball Research Commons'. Includes the proof-of-concept Evidence Map, coding manual, PR-MDS specification and variable dictionary, field measurement protocol, and related reproducibility metadata. The 28-record Evidence Map is an AI-assisted, abstract-level, single-coded discovery seed and is not an exhaustive systematic review.
notes: Reserve the DOI in the Zenodo draft before finalizing the journal manuscript, then insert the reserved DOI into the Availability of data and materials statement and the data citation reference.
